        min_sse = sse
        best_breakpoint = i
        best_params = (params1, params2)

# Refine search around best breakpoint

    sse, params1, params2 = fit_two_segments(temperature, density, i)
    if sse < min_sse:
        min_sse = sse
        best_breakpoint = i
        best_params = (params1, params2)

# Extract Tg

slope2, intercept2 = best_params[1]

print(f"\nHigh-T (liquid) segment:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope1:.6f} g/cm³/K")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept1:.4f}")
print(f"\nLow-T (glass) segment:")
print(f"  Slope: {slope2:.6f} g/cm³/K")
print(f"  Intercept: {intercept2:.4f}")
print(f"\nSlope ratio (liquid/glass): {abs(slope1/slope2):.2f}")

# Save result
